sloka: शतं वाहसहस्राणां तण्डुलानां वपुष्मताम् ।अयुतं तिलमुद्गानां प्रयात्वग्रे महाबल ।। ७.९१.१९ ॥
transliteration: śataṁ vāhasahasrāṇāṁ taṇḍulānāṁ vapuṣmatām ।ayutaṁ tilamudgānāṁ prayātvagre mahābala ।। 7.91.19 ॥

translations.english: O mighty one, let a hundred thousand cartloads of excellent rice grains and ten thousand cartloads of sesame and mung beans be sent ahead.
